comparison.objective: Open a sliding wardrobe door, shelve a sweater through the doorway, and close the door.
comparison.physical_skill: Door sliding plus compliant garment placement through an access opening.
comparison.success_condition: All three stages complete without passing the sweater over a wall or door; no detailed tolerances are given.
comparison.reason: Tests articulated access management and deformable-object shelving, not impact fracture and loose-fragment containment.
